prompts.name: idle
prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production game IDLE sprite sheet based exactly on the attached walking model, not a redesign. Faithfully match this exact elderly Brazilian rural grandma: round black glasses, expressive aged face and white brows, white hair tied back, wide straw-yellow hat with red band, mustard-yellow rolled-sleeve dress/shirt, dark brown gardening gloves, green apron with small yellow flower/cross pattern, brown leggings and green rubber boots. Preserve chunky crisp pixel clusters and strong dark brown outlines, warm limited-looking colors, original stout body proportions and three-quarter view facing right. No younger face, no beard, no different outfit. Exactly FOUR frames in a regular 2 columns by 2 rows grid: relaxed neutral, gentle breath in, small blink/breath out, return neutral. Feet planted. Empty gloved hands rest beside apron, no shovel in this idle. Tiny motion only, identical facial design and apron pattern. Full body sprites, consistent size in all cells, shared foot baseline, generous fully transparent gutters around every pose, no clipped hat or boots. REAL transparent RGBA background. Remove all magenta and any shadow/ground line; no white, gray or checkerboard backdrop, no text, labels, borders or watermark. Frame order is left to right then next row.

prompts.name: run
prompts.prompt: Create a clean production sprite sheet for a humorous determined grandma RUNNING, identity-preserving, based on attached model. Match the specific elderly grandma in the references: white tied-back hair, round black spectacles, warm wrinkled face, straw-yellow broad hat/red band, mustard yellow dress, green apron with yellow flower-crosses, brown gardening gloves, brown leggings, green rubber boots. Stout elderly proportions, crisp chunky shaded pixel art, brown dark outlines, three-quarter view facing right. TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, no background color or halo or vignette or checkerboard, no shadows, no text or grid borders. All complete figures and props contained with transparent gutters. Regular 4 columns by 2 rows grid of exactly EIGHT poses, same body scale, same baseline. Eight-frame complete in-place run cycle. Both halves: right foot forward contact, compression, passing, airborne; left foot forward contact, compression, passing, airborne. Distinct alternating forward boot. Stronger boot stride than walk but sturdy elderly anatomy, gently bent pumping gloved arms, slight forward lean; apron swings slightly and never changes pattern. No tools, no duplicate leading-leg poses.
